ontology.note: PROV computation, WGS84 UTM calculation CRS, and GeoSPARQL CRS84 center geometry. A weighted run also asserts fw:weightField and fw:weightTotal, declared in ontology/fieldwork.ttl and emitted from src/mean-center.ts; the definition site named above asserts nothing itself.

changes.description: Optional weightField: each point is weighted by a named record attribute, with the field and the weight total asserted in the receipt beside the unchanged point count. Unweighted when no field is given.

evidence.note: Numeric projection and SHACL checks; no privacy guarantee. Parity for 0.1.0 established that proj4js and PROJ agree on the UTM transform and that the average is unweighted as declared; it has not been re-run for the weighted path, and the gate reports that it does not cover this release.
